notes.title: Tales Of Wakana is participating in the Steam New Products Festival.
notes.notes:
The New Year is approaching, the horizontal platform adventure game "Legend of Wakana" developed by indie game producer @ Orange Tiger Gamer will participate in the Steam New Products Festival event today, and we are very much looking forward to everyone's demo and play experience, INDIECN would like to wish everyone a happy new year in advance~! 

Legend of Wakana is a pixel-style platform adventure game that will take you into a world full of mystery and challenges. In this vast continent you will face a variety of monsters and scenarios, flexibly utilizing your magical skills to fight against these enemies, and ultimately harvesting a unique spiritual experience in your quest to pursue the true meaning of life, family bonds, and self-knowledge.
